title: Fox Tucson Theatre
geometryBasis: Mapped historic auditorium and lobby, separate marquee canopy and five cleared February 2012 Qualla originals.
sectionBasis: Congress Street lobby with stepped Art Deco coping and ticket booth; west fly loft and auditorium beneath a curved bowstring roof.
limitations: The February 2012 originals control the Congress Street entrance, replica signs, coping and ticket booth. Individual sign flourishes, lettering construction and tilework are simplified.

The curved auditorium roof and west fly loft follow the National Register description. Their heights and unpictured service elevations are approximate. The separate adjacent shops and later expansion are outside the modeled theatre scope.
The elevation field is unchanged. Pavement contact is approximate and is sampled from the original terrain.
